(b) Because you practice yoga for flexibility, you might use that familiarity to flow through a short series like mountain pose, side stretches, and gentle shoulder rolls during travel breaks, ensuring you arrive at the evening event feeling both limber and alert.
(c) If you spend long hours traveling, a few standing stretches such as upper back openers, neck rolls, and calf raises—paired with occasional short walks—can maintain mobility and help you feel refreshed before an evening engagement.
(d) Drawing on your usual morning yoga routine, try incorporating brief, travel-friendly variations of cat-cow stretches and seated hip openers in a quiet corner of the airport or train station; they can reset your posture and restore energy after prolonged sitting.
